scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nightshift/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace=@nightshift/server && npm run build --workspace=@nightshift/server && npm run build --workspace=@nightshift/desktop
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --workspace=@nightshift/shared && npm run build:renderer --workspace=@nightshift/desktop
scripts.deploy:web: npm run vercel-build && vercel deploy apps/desktop/dist --prod --project dist --yes
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace=@nightshift/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@nightshift/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nightshift/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nightshift/desktop
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=@nightshift/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace=@nightshift/server && npm run build --workspace=@nightshift/server
scripts.start:server: npm run db:migrate --workspace=@nightshift/server && npm run start --workspace=@nightshift/server
